description: India's capital — a living museum of Mughal, British colonial, and modern India with iconic monuments, street food, and bazaars.

places.name: Red Fort (Lal Qila) — UNESCO World Heritage
places.address: Netaji Subhash Marg, Lal Qila, Chandni Chowk, New Delhi 110006
places.description: Iconic 17th-century Mughal fort built by Emperor Shah Jahan. UNESCO World Heritage Site and the site of India's Independence Day celebrations every year.

places.name: Qutb Minar Complex — UNESCO World Heritage
places.description: Built in 1193, the 73-metre tall Qutb Minar is the world's tallest brick minaret. The complex includes India's oldest mosque (Quwwat ul-Islam).

places.name: Humayun's Tomb — UNESCO World Heritage
places.address: Mathura Road, Nizamuddin East, New Delhi 110013
places.description: Built in 1572, this Mughal mausoleum is the first garden-tomb in India and the prototype for the Taj Mahal. Set in spectacular Charbagh formal gardens.

places.name: India Gate (War Memorial)
places.address: Kartavya Path, India Gate, New Delhi 110001
places.description: India's most visited landmark — a 42m war memorial dedicated to 82,000 Indian soldiers of WWI. Spectacular at sunset when it's illuminated against the sky.

places.name: Chandni Chowk Bazaar (Oldest Market in India)
places.description: One of India's oldest and busiest markets, built by Mughal Emperor Shah Jahan in 1650. Famous for street food, wholesale markets, and specialty lanes for every trade.

places.name: Karim's Restaurant (Legendary Mughlai since 1913)
places.address: 16 Gali Kababian, Jama Masjid, Old Delhi 110006
places.description: Delhi's most legendary Mughlai restaurant, established in 1913 by descendants of a royal Mughal cook. Famous for Mutton Burra, Nihari, and old-Delhi-style biryani.

places.name: Paranthe Wali Gali (Famous Paratha Lane, Old Delhi)
places.address: Gali Paranthe Wali, Chandni Chowk, Old Delhi 110006
places.description: Delhi's most famous food lane, operating since the Mughal era. Street vendors serve 50+ varieties of stuffed parathas — from rabri to paneer to dry fruits.

places.name: Lodhi Garden (15th-Century Mughal Tombs & Park)
places.description: 90-acre park dotted with 15th and 16th-century Mughal tombs (Sayyid and Lodi dynasties). One of Delhi's most beautiful green spaces — perfect for morning or evening walks.
